## Executive Summary

We are building a **Task Management App** that converts meeting notes into actionable tasks with AI-powered owner/deadline extraction. The app will be evaluated on:

1. **Understanding of the problem** (25%) - Clear problem statement + user pain points
2. **Functionality** (25%) - Does the core flow work end-to-end?
3. **Creativity** (25%) - AI features, unique UX, differentiators
4. **Presentation** (25%) - UI/aesthetics, demo storytelling, polish

**Success Criteria for 48hrs:**
- ✅ Live, working task management app
- ✅ Core flow: Paste meeting notes → AI extracts tasks → Edit & assign → Track on board
- ✅ Full CRUD on tasks (create, read, update, delete, complete)
- ✅ Functional task board with status tracking
- ✅ AI extraction feature (must-have wow factor)
- ✅ Professional demo walkthrough (3-5 mins)

## Phase-by-Phase Breakdown

### **PHASE 1: IDEATION & ARCHITECTURE** (Hours 0-6)
**Objective:** Lock down scope, problem statement, architecture, and PRD

#### 1.1 Problem & User Definition (1 hour)

**Problem Statement:**
> Team members and project managers spend hours manually converting meeting notes into task items, assigning owners, and setting deadlines. Information gets lost, deadlines are missed, and accountability is unclear. Existing tools require manual task creation, making the process tedious and error-prone.

**Target User:**
- **Primary:** Project managers, team leads, scrum masters (25-45 years old)
- **Context:** Daily standups, sprint planning, client calls, team meetings
- **Pain Points:**
  1. Meeting notes scattered across emails, notebooks, Slack threads
  2. Manual extraction of action items is time-consuming and error-prone
  3. No clear owner assignment or deadline visibility across the team

**MVP Success Metric:**
> A user can paste meeting notes, AI extracts 5+ action items with owners and deadlines, user reviews and edits them, and tracks completion on a task board—all in under 3 minutes.

---

#### 1.2 Architecture & Tech Stack Decision (1 hour)

**Recommended Stack (for 48-hour speed):**

| Layer | Technology | Why |
|-------|-----------|-----|
| **Frontend** | Bolt.new or Lovable | Fastest MVP with AI assistance, built-in responsive UI |
| **Backend** | Supabase (PostgreSQL) | Real-time DB, auth included, minimal setup |
| **AI Service** | OpenAI API (GPT-4 mini or Claude) | Task extraction, summarization |
| **Backup & Collab** | GitHub (private repo) | Version control, team collaboration |
| **Deployment** | Vercel (via Bolt) | One-click, serverless, free tier sufficient |

**Data Model:**

```
Tables:
1. users
   - id (UUID)
   - email
   - name
   - created_at

2. projects
   - id (UUID)
   - user_id (FK)
   - name
   - description
   - created_at

3. tasks
   - id (UUID)
   - project_id (FK)
   - title
   - description
   - assigned_to (email or name)
   - status (pending, in-progress, completed)
   - due_date
   - priority (low, medium, high)
   - source (meeting notes / manual)
   - created_at
   - updated_at

4. meeting_notes (optional, for audit trail)
   - id (UUID)
   - project_id (FK)
   - raw_text
   - extracted_tasks_count
   - created_at
```

**Core Screens:**
1. **Home / Dashboard** - Task overview, recent meetings
2. **Paste Meeting Notes** - Text input, AI extraction trigger
3. **Review Extracted Tasks** - Show AI results, edit/confirm before saving
4. **Task Board** - Kanban view (Pending → In Progress → Completed)
5. **Task Detail** - Full task info, edit, reassign, change deadline
6. **Settings** - User profile, project settings

#### 1.4 PRD Creation (2 hours)

**Product Requirements Document**

**1. Goal**
Enable teams to convert meeting notes into actionable tasks in seconds, with AI-powered owner and deadline extraction, eliminating manual task creation overhead.

**2. Target Users**
- Project managers (primary)
- Scrum masters
- Team leads
- Anyone running meetings with action items

**3. Core User Flows**

**Flow 1: Meeting Notes → Task Board (PRIMARY)**
```
User enters app
  ↓
Create/select project
  ↓
Paste meeting notes (textarea)
  ↓
Click "Extract Tasks"
  ↓
AI processes text → returns task list with:
   - Title
   - Description (summary)
   - Assigned to (person name or email)
   - Due date (extracted or default +7 days)
   - Priority (inferred from language)
  ↓
User reviews extracted tasks
  ↓
User can edit title, owner, deadline, description
  ↓
Click "Save to Board"
  ↓
Tasks appear on Kanban board (Pending column)
```

**Flow 2: Manual Task Creation**
```
User clicks "Add Task" button
  ↓
Fill task form (title, owner, due date, description)
  ↓
Save → task appears on board
```

**Flow 3: Task Management**
```
User sees task board
  ↓
Drag task between columns (Pending → In Progress → Completed)
  ↓
Click task → edit details, reassign, change deadline
  ↓
Mark complete → task moves to Done column
```

**4. Success Metrics (for demo)**
- User can paste 200+ word meeting notes
- AI extracts 5+ tasks correctly
- User can edit and save tasks in <1 minute
- Task board displays all tasks with visual status
- No crashes or blank states

**5. Out of Scope (for this 48-hour MVP)**
- Real-time collaboration (multi-user editing)
- Email/Slack notifications
- Complex permission models
- Mobile app
- Task dependencies or subtasks
- Time tracking or comments

#### 2.1 Platform Selection & Setup (1 hour)

Why Bolt over Lovable:

3. Fork to GitHub immediately (for backup)
4. Create Supabase project (free tier, 1 DB)
5. Set up environment variables in Bolt

---

#### 2.2 Supabase Backend Setup (1.5 hours)

**Step 1: Create Supabase Project**
- Go to supabase.com
- Sign up / login
- Create new project (region: closest to you)
- Wait for DB to be ready (~2 min)

**Step 2: Create Tables & Schema**

Run these SQL queries in Supabase SQL editor:

```sql
-- Users table (Supabase auth handles this, but we'll extend)
CREATE TABLE public.users (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  email TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  name TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- Projects table
CREATE TABLE public.projects (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  description TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- Tasks table
CREATE TABLE public.tasks (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  project_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES public.projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  title TEXT NOT NULL,
  description TEXT,
  assigned_to TEXT, -- email or name
  status TEXT DEFAULT 'pending', -- pending, in_progress, completed
  due_date DATE,
  priority TEXT DEFAULT 'medium', -- low, medium, high
  source TEXT DEFAULT 'manual', -- manual, extracted
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- Enable RLS (Row Level Security)
ALTER TABLE public.users ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public.projects ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public.tasks ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

-- RLS Policies (allow users to see their own data)
CREATE POLICY "Users can read own data" ON public.users
  FOR SELECT USING (auth.uid() = id);

CREATE POLICY "Users can see own projects" ON public.projects
  FOR SELECT USING (auth.uid() = user_id);

CREATE POLICY "Users can insert own projects" ON public.projects
  FOR INSERT WITH CHECK (auth.uid() = user_id);

CREATE POLICY "Users can see tasks in own projects" ON public.tasks
  FOR SELECT USING (
    project_id IN (SELECT id FROM public.projects WHERE user_id = auth.uid())
  );

CREATE POLICY "Users can insert tasks in own projects" ON public.tasks
  FOR INSERT WITH CHECK (
    project_id IN (SELECT id FROM public.projects WHERE user_id = auth.uid())
  );

CREATE POLICY "Users can update tasks in own projects" ON public.tasks
  FOR UPDATE USING (
    project_id IN (SELECT id FROM public.projects WHERE user_id = auth.uid())
  );

CREATE POLICY "Users can delete tasks in own projects" ON public.tasks
  FOR DELETE USING (
    project_id IN (SELECT id FROM public.projects WHERE user_id = auth.uid())
  );
```

**Step 3: Get Connection String**
- Go to Supabase project settings → API
- Copy `SUPABASE_URL` and `SUPABASE_ANON_KEY`
- Save these for Bolt environment variables

#### 2.3 Bolt Starting Prompt (Optimized for Task Management)

**Use this exact prompt in Bolt.new:**

```
You are building a Task Management MVP in 48 hours. Follow these rules:

PRODUCT:
- App name: "TaskFlow"
- Purpose: Convert meeting notes into actionable tasks with AI-powered extraction
- Tech: React, TypeScript, Tailwind, Supabase, OpenAI API

CORE FLOWS (Build in this order):
1. User authentication (email/password signup + login)
2. Create a project (simple form)
3. Paste meeting notes + AI extraction
4. Review & edit extracted tasks
5. Kanban task board (Pending, In Progress, Done)
6. Edit individual tasks (title, owner, deadline, status)
7. Mark tasks complete

SCREENS REQUIRED:
1. Auth Screen (login/signup)
2. Dashboard (list of projects + "New Project" button)
3. Meeting Notes Input Screen
   - Text area for meeting notes
   - "Extract Tasks" button
   - Loading state while AI processes
4. Task Review Screen (after extraction)
   - Show extracted tasks in a table/list
   - Allow inline editing of title, owner, due_date, description
   - "Save to Board" button
5. Task Board Screen (main view)
   - 3 columns: Pending | In Progress | Done
   - Drag-and-drop between columns (or buttons to move)
   - Task cards showing: title, owner, due_date, priority badge
   - "Add Task" button to create manually
   - Click task to edit details
6. Task Detail/Edit Screen
   - Full task info
   - Edit all fields
   - Delete button
   - Back to board

DATA MODEL:
- Projects: id, name, description, user_id, created_at
- Tasks: id, project_id, title, description, assigned_to, status, due_date, priority, source, created_at

UI/UX REQUIREMENTS:
- Clean, modern design (grays, blues, accent color for primary actions)
- Mobile responsive (should work on mobile too)
- Clear visual distinction between statuses (color coding)
- Loading states and error messages
- No blank screens; always show helpful empty states

AI EXTRACTION (USE OPENAI):
When user pastes meeting notes and clicks "Extract Tasks":
1. Send the notes to OpenAI API (GPT-4 mini is fine)
2. Prompt: "Extract all action items from these meeting notes. For each item, identify: 1) Task title (2-5 words), 2) Description (what needs to be done), 3) Owner (person name or 'Unassigned'), 4) Due date (if mentioned, else '+7 days'), 5) Priority (high/medium/low based on language). Return as JSON array with fields: title, description, assigned_to, due_date, priority"
3. Parse the JSON response
4. Display extracted tasks for user review
5. Let user edit before saving

IMPORTANT:
- Focus on functionality over polish (working > pretty)
- Use Supabase for all data (never hardcoded data)
- Make sure tasks persist across page refreshes
- No need for real-time collaboration yet
- Deploy to Vercel when done
- Use environment variables for API keys (SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY)

START WITH: Auth + Dashboard, then Meeting Notes Input, then AI Extraction, then Task Board.
```

#### 2.5 Key Implementation Notes

**Authentication:**
- Use Supabase Auth (Email/Password)
- Simple signup form
- Session management handled by Supabase SDK

**AI Extraction Prompt (refined):**
```
You are a task extraction assistant. Given meeting notes, extract all action items.

For EACH action item, identify:
1. Task title (2-5 words, clear action verb)
2. Description (full context, 1-2 sentences)
3. Owner (person name, email, or "Unassigned" if not mentioned)
4. Due date (in YYYY-MM-DD format; if mentioned in notes use that, else assume +7 days from today; today is [TODAY_DATE])
5. Priority (high/medium/low based on urgency words like "urgent", "ASAP", "today", "this week")

Meeting notes:
[PASTE_MEETING_NOTES_HERE]

Return ONLY valid JSON (no markdown, no extra text):
[
  {
    "title": "...",
    "description": "...",
    "assigned_to": "...",
    "due_date": "YYYY-MM-DD",
    "priority": "high|medium|low"
  }
]
```

**Error Handling:**
- If API key is missing, show clear error message
- If extraction fails, show raw text with "Try again" button
- If Supabase connection fails, show offline message

**Empty States:**
- No projects yet → "Create your first project"
- No tasks yet → "Paste meeting notes or add a task manually"
- AI extraction loading → Spinner with "Extracting tasks..."

## Risk Mitigation

| Risk | Mitigation |
|------|-----------|
| AI API fails during demo | Have fallback sample extraction ready to paste |
| Supabase connection drops | Test database before demo, have backup data |
| Vercel deployment breaks | Keep localhost running as backup, use screen recording |
| Time runs out | Prioritize: Auth → Dashboard → Meeting notes → Board → AI (in that order) |
| Forgot API keys | Store in 1Password or secure note; rehearse retrieval |
| Browser caching issues | Use incognito mode for final demo |

## Key Success Factors

1. **Lock scope early** → Don't add features mid-build
2. **AI extraction must work** → This is your wow factor
3. **Kanban board must be visual** → Drag-drop or clear buttons
4. **Demo must be smooth** → Practice 3-5 times before recording
5. **Deployment before presentation** → No "this works locally" excuses
6. **Clean code & GitHub** → Judges may review code

---

## Final Checklist Before Submission

- [ ] Live app deployed and accessible
- [ ] All core flows work without errors
- [ ] AI extraction produces valid JSON and displays correctly
- [ ] Task board displays and allows status changes
- [ ] Loom video recorded (2.5-3.5 min, clear audio, professional)
- [ ] Pitch deck complete and compelling (5-7 slides)
- [ ] GitHub repo clean with good commit messages
- [ ] Team names and emails documented
- [ ] README added to GitHub
- [ ] All links tested in fresh browser
- [ ] Submission form filled completely
- [ ] Submitted through official portal only
